description: Render one page of a local PDF as a PNG image (about 100 dpi), or return an image file (PNG, JPG, WebP) itself. Read-only: never modifies or uploads the file. Use it only for pages listed in visualPages by distill_file or distill_outline, and only when the question depends on the chart or image on that page: it costs far more tokens than the Markdown. One page per call (page is the physical page number, 1-based, as listed in visualPages.page). Fails with bad_request (other file types, page out of range), forbidden (outside allowed roots), too_large (over 100 MB), not_found or parse_failed.

page.description: Physical page number (1-based position in the PDF), as listed in visualPages.page; use 1 for an image file

path.description: Absolute path, or relative to the server's working directory

name: distill_page_image
title: View one page of a PDF as an image
